[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Brilliance Aura had a common rarity instead of rare.

Fixed an issue where Illumination was triggering an additional mana regen effect.

[Legendary Astral Bomber] displayed an incorrect tooltip. Tooltip has been updated pending patch.

Transforms Starfire into Astral Flare. Astral Flare deals Spellfire damage. 
Your Fireball and Fireblast can trigger Eclipse(Lunar). Requires Rank 3 of Eclipse.

During Solar Eclipse, your Fireball and Pyroblast hits grant you a stack of Lunar Bomber. Lunar Bomber in
creases your Astral Flare damage by 1% per stack each time you cast Astral Flare. You lose all stacks of Lunar Bomber when Eclipse (Lunar) ends.

Your Astral Flare strikes during Lunar Eclipse grants you a stack of Solar Bomber. Solar Bomber increases your Fireball and Pyroblast damage by 1% per stack each time you cast them. You lose all stacks of Solar Bomber when Eclipse (Solar) ends.

Demonic Resillience now increases the threat generated while in metamorphosis by 100/200/300% up from 25/50/75% since the tank rework. This is mainly to mitigate Righteous Fury no longer stacking with Metamorphosis and to limit threat as the primary mechanic as a Metamorphosis tank.
[Pending restart] Stamina now grants 12 health, changed from 10.

[Pending restart] The damage increase of the Filthy Trick capstone effect is now 10%, changed from 15%.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Divinity wasn't functioning correctly.
[Pending restart] [New Capstone] Improved Charge - Increases the range of Charge by 5 yards.
[Malganis] Charge now shares a cooldown with other gap closer abilities, such as Intercept and Shadowstep.
[Malganis] Charge now has a 18 second cooldown, changed from 30 seconds.
[Pending restart] [Area 52][Alar] Charge now has a 25 second cooldown, changed from 30 seconds.
[Pending restart] Improved Charge has been reworked. It no longer reduces the cooldown of charge but instead increases the duration of your Charge root by 0.33/0.66/1 seconds.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Mana-forged Barrier didn't grant interrupt immunity correctly.
Taking damage from tank dummies can no longer cause you to Stagger (as this damage would previously kill you)

[Mal'Ganis][New Level 20 Arcane Mage Talent] Power Surge - While casting a damaging spell, melee attacks against you have a chance to cause a Power Surge of the school you are casting. The Surge deals damage shared between all nearby enemies and also restores 3/6/9% of your missing mana. Can only occur once per second.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Mana-Forged Barrier - Envelops you in a Mana-fueled Barrier, protecting you from damage at the expense of mana. Depending on your mana percentage, the Barrier will absorb from 90% to 40% of the damage you take, draining 1 mana per point absorbed. The Barrier also protects you against most effects that would interrupt your ongoing spell cast (does not work against players). Also increases the threat generated by Magic damage significantly but reduces your damage and healing done by 50%.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Invocation - Channeling this spell empowers your Mana-forged Barrier, removing its mana cost and making it absorb damage as if you were at full mana. While channeling you will periodically discharge projectiles of raw mana, dealing high-threat Magic damage to nearby enemies. Lasts 3 seconds.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Alter Time - Alter the fabric of time, causing the caster to return to their current location, their health and mana, when cast a second time, or after $d. Any self-applied, magic dispellable effects are also returned to their previous state. Effect negated if the caster dies within the $d before the effect occurs or moves too far away.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Redirect - Transfers any existing combo points to the current enemy target. Requires active combo points.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Avatar - Transform into an unstoppable colossus for 10 seconds, causing you to deal 10% increased Physical damage and take 10% less damage. While in this state your movement speed can not be reduced below nor be increased above normal running speed. You are also immune to immobilizing effects.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Capacitor Totem - Summons an Air totem with 5 health within 20 yards that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and then explodes after 1 sec to deal Nature damage and stun all enemies within 8 yards for 4 sec. This ability is usable while shapeshifted.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Dispatch - Finishing move that causes damage per combo point. If used on a target below 35% health, your next Eviscerate, Envenom or Rupture deals 20% increased damage.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Skull Banner - Throw down a war banner at your feet that increases the melee and ranged critical strike chance of party or raid members within 40 yards of the banner by 20%. Lasts 10 seconds. Allies receiving this effect will become Fatigued and unable to benefit from Skull Banner for 180 seconds. You can Intervene to your war banner.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Earthquake - You cause the earth at the target location to tremble and break, dealing Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies and reducing their movement speed by 20% in an 8 yard radius. Lasts 8 seconds. Enemies taking damage from it are affected with Trembling and on 3 stacks they get stunned for 3 seconds. This can only occur every 10 sec from any Earthquake effect.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Solar Beam - You summon a beam of solar light, silencing all enemies under the beam while it is active. Solar Beam lasts for 6 sec.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Blood Horror - While channeling, encases yourself in a barrier of blood. Any time an enemy within 8 yards deals non-periodic damage to you, you drain their health and cause them to run in horror for 3 seconds.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Colossus Smash - Smashes a target for 130% weapon damage which ignores armor and then weakens their defenses, allowing your attacks to bypass 30% of their armor for 6 seconds.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Leap of Faith - Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you. The same target can only be affected by this once every 30 seconds.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Demonic Leap - Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Stampeding Roar - You roar, increasing the movement speed of all party or raid members within 10 yards by 60% for 6 seconds. Does not break prowling.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Smoke Bomb - Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around you for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud. You take 40% less damage for 5 seconds after using Smoke Bomb.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Combat Readiness - Enter a state of heightened defensive awareness. Each time you're hit by a melee or ranged attack you reduce your overall damage taken by 5%, for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times. Lasts 20 seconds or until not attacked for 10 seconds.

[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Windwalk Totem - Summons an Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 6 sec, granting party members within 10 yards Windwalk. Their movement speed can not go below 100% speed while affected.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Void Shift - You and the currently targeted party or raid member swap health percentages. Increases the lower health percentage of the two to 25% if below that amount.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Mass Entanglement - Roots the target and all enemies within 8 yards in place for 30 sec (6 sec versus players). Damage may interrupt the effect.
[Mal'Ganis][New Ability] Unending Resolve - You harden your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and preventing you from being silenced, or your spells from being interrupted for 8 seconds.
